routesText: the routes for each race will be published here before race day.
kitIntro: Collect your race kit at the place you chose when registering:
kitDates: Collection dates and times will be announced here and sent to registered participants.
bring: The phone number you registered with
Proof of payment if your payment is not yet confirmed
Student ID or club card if you registered as a student or club member
For children: a parent or guardian collects the kit

tips.title: Arrive early
tips.text: Give yourself time to park, warm up and find your start area at C.D. Msuya Stadium.

tips.title: Wear your race number
tips.text: Pin your bib on the front of your T-shirt so marshals and photographers can see it.

tips.title: Run safely
tips.text: Follow the marshals, drink water, and stop if you feel unwell — your health comes first.

tips.title: Children with their family
tips.text: Children walk or run the 2.5 km Walking Safari together with a parent or guardian.

tips.title: Stay for the awards
tips.text: Medals and prizes for the winners at midday, then tug of war and the Mwanga Utalii Festival.

tips.title: Explore Mwanga
tips.text: Make a weekend of it — discover the mountains, lakes, food and culture around Mwanga.

ctaText: Check your registration with your ID and phone number, or call us.
